subject: API integration down since this morning

subject: Export corrupted file

body: Same corrupted export issue as May, this time on a different report. Would be good to understand if there's a common cause.

body: Second export issue in as many days. Your team fixes these fast, credit where due, but it's a lot of tickets for one week.

subject: Scheduled export not delivering to SharePoint
body:
We have a scheduled export configured to push to our SharePoint folder every Monday morning. This week it didn't run. The export history shows the job as 'Completed' but there's no file in the destination. Could you check what happened? The export name is 'Weekly KPI Pack'.

Pekka Lindqvist
Head of Reporting

subject: Seat count showing incorrectly in billing summary
body:
Our billing summary page shows 18 active seats but we only have 14 active users. I've reviewed the user list - there's no obvious explanation for the discrepancy. We're coming up to renewal and want to make sure the seat count is correct before any invoice is generated. Please can someone check.

Pekka Lindqvist
Head of Reporting

subject: Google Sheets connector - auth error after token refresh
body: Getting an authentication error on our Google Sheets connector after re-authorising the OAuth token yesterday. Error says 'Scope mismatch - required scopes not granted' but I went through the auth flow and accepted all requested permissions. Quick one hopefully. Pekka.

subject: Calculated field formula not saving correctly
body:
I've built a calculated field using a ratio formula in Report Builder. Every time I save the report and reopen it, the formula has reverted to a previous (incorrect) version. I've reproduced this four times now. The reports_created count in our team has dropped because people are giving up and working around it in spreadsheets - which rather defeats the purpose. Can this be looked at as a priority?

Pekka Lindqvist
Head of Reporting

subject: Monthly export pack - missing three report tabs
body:
The scheduled monthly export for February is missing three of the six report tabs that were present in January's output. Nothing was changed in the report configuration between runs. I've raised issues before about the exports and the calculator field, both of which took a while to sort. This is now affecting month-end close. A week to resolve this would be the minimum acceptable but I'd prefer faster.

Pekka Lindqvist
Head of Reporting

subject: Alert rule disappeared again
body: Forecast deviation alert rule vanished on its own, no one deleted it. Happened before too. Check the audit log? Pekka.

subject: Alert rule gone — third time now
body: Forecast deviation alert gone again, third time. Previous ticket called it one-time — clearly wasn't. Six days is not acceptable. Pekka.

subject: Dashboard permissions not applying correctly
body:
I've restricted a dashboard to specific user groups but users outside those groups are still able to access it. Checked the permission settings twice - everything looks correct on our end. The dashboard contains sensitive financial data and this is not a minor inconvenience. Nine days is too long for a security-related issue - please escalate.

Pekka Lindqvist
Head of Reporting

subject: Q1 export pack still not working
body:
The export issue from March has not been fully resolved. The Q1 consolidated export ran this morning and is again missing tabs. We're in Q1 close right now - this is a significant problem. I've lost count of how many tickets we've raised in the last two months. If this isn't fixed properly soon I'll need to escalate to account management.

Pekka Lindqvist
Head of Reporting

subject: ERP connector sync - incremental mode not working
body: The ERP connector is running full syncs every cycle instead of incremental. Storage consumption on our end is fine but the sync time has gone from 4 minutes to 45 minutes, which means the data isn't ready when people need it in the morning. Logging it. Pekka.

subject: Drill-down stopped working on financial overview dashboard
body:
The drill-down functionality on the financial overview dashboard stopped working this week. Clicking a chart segment does nothing. It worked correctly before. Logging this - please fix when you can.

Pekka Lindqvist

subject: Webhook events not being delivered
body:
Webhook events for data refresh completion stopped being delivered to our endpoint around 28 May. The endpoint is healthy and responding 200 to test pings. Our downstream system relies on these events to trigger processing. Six days to resolve is on the long side for something that just stopped working with no configuration changes on our end.

Pekka Lindqvist
Head of Reporting

subject: Export format changed without notice
body: The July monthly export came through in a different column order than all previous months. Nothing was changed on our side. This broke an automated import process downstream. Please restore the previous column order, or at least give advance warning when output formats change. Pekka.

subject: API returning empty response for one endpoint
body: The /reports endpoint has started returning an empty array even though we have active reports. Other endpoints are fine. Can you check?

subject: Seat count showing incorrectly on billing page
body: Our billing page shows 14 seats used but we only have 11 active users. Could you reconcile this before our next invoice?

subject: Follow-up on seat count issue
body: Adding to what was raised yesterday about the seat count - we'd also like to understand how the count is calculated, since a couple of deactivated users still seem to be included.

subject: Chart type missing in report builder
body: The stacked bar chart option seems to have disappeared from the chart type list in report builder. Was there a recent change?

subject: Report builder loading slowly
body: Report builder has been noticeably slower to open reports this week, taking 10+ seconds where it used to be instant. Just flagging in case others are seeing it too.

subject: Report builder slow again
body: Same slowness reported a couple of weeks ago is still happening for me today. Worth a look if it hasn't already been resolved.

subject: Export file naming
body: Exported files are all named 'export.pdf' regardless of report name, which makes it hard to keep track of multiple downloads. Could the file name include the report title?

subject: Dashboard tile misaligned
body: One tile on our operations dashboard is overlapping the one next to it since a layout change last week. Cosmetic but worth fixing.

subject: API documentation out of date
body: The API docs still reference the old authentication method, which caused some confusion setting up a new integration. Could these be updated? Took a bit of back and forth to get it working.

subject: Alert threshold reset after edit
body: Edited an alert threshold and it reverted back to the original value the next day. Can you check if there's a caching issue?

subject: Quick API question - pagination
body: Is there a documented limit on page size for the /transactions endpoint? Getting inconsistent results above 500 records.

subject: Dashboard export button missing
body: The export button on one of our custom dashboards has disappeared, though it's still there on others. Same permissions on all of them as far as I can tell.

subject: Pagination behaviour on /reports endpoint
body: Working on a script to pull all report metadata via the API and running into inconsistent pagination on the /reports endpoint — sometimes the next-page cursor repeats the same page. Can you confirm the expected pagination behaviour, ideally with a small example? Also, is there a documented limit on results per page beyond the default 100? Would help to have this before we build anything permanent around it. Jens

subject: API pagination bug back again
body: The pagination issue from December has resurfaced — same symptom, cursor occasionally repeating a page on the /reports endpoint, most recently reproduced this morning on three separate pulls. I know it was marked fixed after the December ticket, but either it's regressed or the fix was partial. Happy to share the request/response pairs again if it helps narrow it down faster this time. Jens

subject: Dashboard filters resetting on refresh
body: Every time the scheduled dashboard refresh runs overnight, any custom filters we'd applied during the day get wiped back to default. This means whoever opens the dashboard first each morning has to reapply filters before it's usable, which given how often we're now touching the API for other things feels like an avoidable rough edge. Could this be looked at properly rather than as a one-off? Jens

subject: Pagination bug — third time, still happening
body: Flagging again — the /reports pagination bug we first reported in December and again in March is still there, reproduced yesterday on a pull for our Q3 board pack. At this point we've built our own dedup logic client-side to catch repeated pages, so it's not blocking us, but it would be good to have a real fix eventually rather than working around it indefinitely. For context, we've started trialling Dashlume's API for a couple of internal use cases, partly because of exactly this kind of recurring friction. Jens

subject: Scheduled exports arriving with missing rows
body: Our scheduled weekly export (the finance summary, runs Sunday nights) has been arriving with a handful of rows missing compared to the equivalent dashboard view — spotted it twice now, most recently this week's run. We've started manually cross-checking row counts against the dashboard before we distribute the export, which adds maybe fifteen minutes but at least catches it. Given everything else this year with the API, this is going into the same bucket of things we're weighing as we look at Dashlume more seriously for next year. Jens

subject: Missing rows in export — still happening
body: Same missing-rows issue as earlier this month, again on the Sunday export, again caught by our manual row-count check rather than anything on your side flagging it. We're not chasing this hard since the workaround is holding and nobody downstream has noticed yet, but wanted to keep the thread updated in case it's useful for whoever's looking into the root cause. No need to treat this as urgent. Jens

subject: Bulk export timing out
body: Trying to bulk export five reports at once and it times out every time, though individual exports work fine. Can you look into the bulk export limit?

subject: API errors the day after the alerts issue

Could the PDF export logic be looked at? Juha

Just didn't want it to look like the issue disappeared on its own. No need to prioritise on our end. Juha

Is there a way to generate a time-limited external share link, or would we need to create guest accounts for them? We'd want access to expire automatically once the audit period ends in September. Could you talk us through the options? Marit

subject: API returning stale data intermittently

It's making our downstream automation unreliable since we can't tell which pulls are fresh without cross-checking manually. Would appreciate a look when you get a chance. Tuomas

This delayed a report we needed for a board meeting yesterday, so we ended up pulling the numbers together manually instead. We've started looking more closely at alternatives, Storsund BI among them, partly prompted by moments like this one. Could you look into what's stuck? Marit

It's a similar theme to a few other things we've flagged this year — small inconsistencies rather than outright breakage — and it's part of why Storsund BI keeps coming up in our internal conversations about next year's tooling. Not asking for anything beyond understanding why the expiry didn't hold. Tuomas

subject: Report builder — closing out a few threads
body: Wanted to flag one more thing before quarter close — a saved report template lost its custom column order after the last platform update, similar in spirit to the dashboard and export issues we've raised since last summer. We've rebuilt the template manually, so there's no urgency here. As mentioned before, we're continuing to look at Storsund BI as part of our renewal planning, largely because these small resets have added up to a fair amount of manual tidying over the past year. Marit

subject: Connector setup for new Snowflake warehouse

Could you send over the steps for updating the connection string and re-authenticating, or would this need to be done on your side? Ideally we'd want to do this over a weekend to minimise disruption to daytime reporting. Let me know what you need from us. Tero

subject: Connector still pointing at old warehouse intermittently
body: Since the migration ten days ago, the connector mostly works fine against the new Snowflake instance, but two syncs since then have quietly pulled from the old (now read-only) warehouse instead, meaning we got stale numbers without any error being thrown. That's the concerning part — it fails silently rather than flagging. Could you check whether the old connection details are still cached somewhere? Tero

subject: Dashboard numbers off after the connector mix-up
body: Downstream of the connector issue from before Christmas, we found two dashboards that had been quietly showing numbers from the old warehouse for about a week before anyone noticed, since nothing errored. We've had to manually reconcile those figures in Excel and re-send a corrected report to two department heads, which was an uncomfortable conversation to have. I'd like some assurance this silent-failure mode is being addressed properly, not just the immediate connector fix. Tero

subject: API silently returning cached results
body: Similar shape of problem to the connector issue in December/January — we're now seeing the API occasionally return cached results without any header or flag indicating staleness, discovered when a scheduled job we run against it produced numbers that didn't match a parallel Excel-based check we'd started doing as a precaution since then. Could the API responses include some kind of last-updated timestamp so we can detect this ourselves going forward? Tero

subject: Report builder — scheduled report sent with old template
body: This month's automated report builder send went out using what looks like a cached version of the template from two revisions ago, missing a column we'd added in February. We caught it before it reached the board but it's the same silent-staleness pattern we've now seen across connectors, API and report builder since December. We've started keeping a manual pre-send checklist to catch this ourselves. Tero

subject: Same stale-template issue, two weeks later
body: Happened again — same report, same stale-template symptom as the one from a couple of weeks ago. Our pre-send checklist caught it again before distribution, so no harm done, but I'll note we're now running that check on every scheduled send as standard practice rather than treating it as a one-off. Not asking for immediate escalation, just keeping the record straight given the pattern since December. Tero
